regions.name: Lower observed region
regions.evidence: r01-r08 RGB and measured LIO establish the lower current pose-height region, south hall and west fore-room. Later postVIO tracks the two-flight ascent and landing. The lower hall +y long axis has remote measured returns but no actual traversal as of r20. This is a measured height display, not a global floor boundary or support model.

regions.name: Upper observed region
regions.evidence: r16-r19 RGB show second stair top, landing, open red door and white-tiled blue-wall corridor. r20 RGB expands into the upper hall. Current-generation measured low returns vary spatially from approximately 3.1 m near the stair top to 3.6-3.9 m in the hall. This broad z band is a display selection, not a uniform physical floor, support certificate or building boundary. Orange trace is actual postVIO at the upper pose-height band; gray is the rest of the actual trajectory.
